Employees travelling on business to Tier 1 cities receive a per diem of INR 2,000 per day for meals and incidental expenses. [Doc_10 §1] The per diem for Tier 2 cities and all other domestic locations is INR 1,400 per day. [Doc_10 §2] On departure and return days, employees receive 50 percent of the applicable per diem if they are away for less than 12 hours on that day. Day trips that do not include an overnight stay are paid at 50 percent of the per diem. [Doc_10 §3]
